extracted.intended_audience: users of GAP (mathematicians and computational group theorists) working with polycyclic/pc groups and pcgs
extracted.subtask_description: Reference specification of GAP functions/properties for working with pcgs (polycyclic generating sequences) and pc groups: how to obtain/inspect normal series, special pcgs, actions on factors, orbit/stabilizer methods, pc group construction and cohomology/extension operations.

rubrics_metrics.name: NormalSeriesByPcgsPGroup
rubrics_metrics.description: Let pcgs be a pcgs obtained as corresponding to a series of normal subgroups with p-central elementary abelian factors (for example from calling PcgsPCentralSeriesPGroup). This attribute returns the actual series of normal subgroups, corresponding to IndicesPCentralNormalStepsPGroup.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to retrieve the explicit normal-subgroup series for a pcgs known to come from a p-central series; relies on corresponding IndicesPCentralNormalStepsPGroup.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsPcgsChiefSeries
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns true if the pcgs refines a chief series.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If true, IndicesChiefNormalSteps gives the indices in the pcgs at which the subgroups of the chief series start.

rubrics_metrics.name: PcgsChiefSeries
rubrics_metrics.description: Computes a pcgs for G that refines a chief series.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use when you need a pcgs that yields a refinement of a chief series; IndicesChiefNormalSteps gives the start indices of the normal subgroups in that pcgs.

rubrics_metrics.name: IndicesChiefNormalSteps
rubrics_metrics.description: Given a pcgs corresponding to a chief series (e.g., from PcgsChiefSeries), returns a sorted list of integers indicating the tails of pcgs which generate the normal subgroups of G (if i is in the list, (g_i,...,g_n) is a normal subgroup).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The list always starts with 1 and ends with n+1. These indices form one series with elementary abelian subfactors, not necessarily the most refined one. ChiefNormalSeriesByPcgs returns the actual subgroups. For arbitrary pcgs not belonging to a special series such indices may not exist and the function may fail. Typically set by PcgsChiefSeries.

rubrics_metrics.name: ChiefNormalSeriesByPcgs
rubrics_metrics.description: For a pcgs obtained from a chief series, returns the actual series of normal subgroups corresponding to IndicesChiefNormalSteps.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use to get subgroup objects (not just indices) of the chief normal series when pcgs was produced by PcgsChiefSeries.

rubrics_metrics.name: IndicesNormalSteps
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns the indices of all steps in the pc series which are normal in the group defined by the pcgs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: General-purpose but slower than specialized index functions for particular series (elementary abelian, central, p-central).

rubrics_metrics.name: NormalSeriesByPcgs
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns the subgroups of the pc series which are normal in the group defined by the pcgs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: General-purpose but may have slower performance than specialized functions (e.g., EANormalSeriesByPcgs, IndicesCentralNormalSteps).

rubrics_metrics.name: SumFactorizationFunctionPcgs
rubrics_metrics.description: Computes the sum and intersection of the lists n and u whose elements form modulo-pcgs elements induced by parentpcgs for two subgroups modulo a kernel kerpcgs. The factor group modulo kerpcgs generated by n must be elementary abelian and normal under u.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If kerpcgs is a tail of the parent-pcgs, giving the starting depth can be more efficient than constructing an explicit pcgs. Returns a record with components: sum (elements forming a modulo-pcgs for the span), intersection (elements forming a modulo-pcgs for the intersection), and factorization (a function that for x in the span returns decomposition into u and n). The sum and intersection are lists of pc elements (not pcgs) to avoid unnecessary induced-pcgs creation.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsSpecialPcgs
rubrics_metrics.description: Tests whether an object is a special pcgs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Special pcgs have properties: refine LG-series, exhibit a Hall system, and exhibit head complements; they permit particularly efficient algorithms.

rubrics_metrics.name: SpecialPcgs
rubrics_metrics.description: Computes a special pcgs for the group defined by pcgs or for G.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A special pcgs records LGWeights, LGLayers and LGFirst; computing one can be beneficial for performance in many algorithms.

rubrics_metrics.name: LGWeights
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns the LGWeights of a special pcgs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each weight is a triple describing (layer index in lower nilpotent series, depth in p-central series of appropriate Sylow factor, prime). Used to record relation to LG-series.

rubrics_metrics.name: LGLayers
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns the layers of the special pcgs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List corresponds to each element of the special pcgs and denotes which layer of the LG-series the element lies in.

rubrics_metrics.name: LGFirst
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns the first indices for each layer of the special pcgs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Gives the number of the first element in the special pcgs of the corresponding subgroup (layer).

rubrics_metrics.name: LGLength
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns the length of the LG-series of the group G if G is solvable; returns fail otherwise.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Useful to detect nilpotency/structure: examples show interpretation (length 1 => nilpotent, etc.).

rubrics_metrics.name: IsInducedPcgsWrtSpecialPcgs
rubrics_metrics.description: Tests whether a pcgs is induced with respect to a special pcgs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Checks compatibility of a pcgs with a given special pcgs to ensure induced pcgs operations behave as expected.

rubrics_metrics.name: InducedPcgsWrtSpecialPcgs
rubrics_metrics.description: Computes an induced pcgs with respect to the special pcgs of the parent of G.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Will return a pcgs induced by a special pcgs (which might differ from the one you expected). If you need an induced pcgs compatible with a given special pcgs, use InducedPcgs (45.7.4) with that special pcgs.

rubrics_metrics.name: VectorSpaceByPcgsOfElementaryAbelianGroup
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns the vector space over a field fld corresponding to the modulo-pcgs mpcgs. mpcgs must define an elementary abelian p-group where p is the characteristic of fld.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use when converting an elementary abelian modulo-pcgs into an explicit vector space for linear/affine action computations.

rubrics_metrics.name: LinearAction / LinearOperation
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns a list of matrices (one per element of gens) corresponding to the matrix action of gens on basisvectors via the supplied linear function.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use to obtain explicit matrix representations of group action on a chosen basis; LinearOperation is an operation form.

rubrics_metrics.name: LinearActionLayer / LinearOperationLayer
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns matrices for each element of gens corresponding to the matrix action of G on the vector space corresponding to the modulo-pcgs pcgs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Layer variants operate on vector spaces defined by a specific pcgs (modulo-pcgs).

rubrics_metrics.name: AffineAction
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns a list of matrices (one per element of gens) corresponding to the affine action of gens on basisvectors using linear part 'linear' with translation 'transl'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use when group action includes translations (affine actions) rather than purely linear actions.

rubrics_metrics.name: AffineActionLayer
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns matrices for the affine action of G on the vector space corresponding to modulo-pcgs pcgs with translation transl.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Layer version works with vector spaces defined by a pcgs modulo tail.

rubrics_metrics.name: StabilizerPcgs
rubrics_metrics.description: Computes the stabilizer in the group generated by pcgs of the point pnt. Optional arguments: acts (elements by which pcgs acts) and act (the acting function).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Returns a pcgs for the stabilizer which is induced by the ParentPcgs of pcgs and is therefore compatible with pcgs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pcgs_OrbitStabilizer
rubrics_metrics.description: Runs a solvable-group orbit-stabilizer algorithm on a point pnt with pcgs acting via images 'oprs' and operation function 'opr'. domain can be used to speed up search or false if unknown.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Returns a record with components: orbit, stabpcgs, and lengths (lengths indicate how orbit was extended and can help recompute transversal elements). Intended for internal/algorithmic use when speed is essential.

rubrics_metrics.name: Special methods for groups with pcgs
rubrics_metrics.description: Certain operations have specialized methods when applied to groups that have pcgs; these include many group-theoretic computations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples of operations with special pcgs methods: IsNilpotentGroup, IsSupersolvableGroup, CompositionSeries, FrattiniSubgroup, PrefrattiniSubgroup, MaximalSubgroups, HallSystem, MinimalGeneratingSet, Centre, Intersection, AutomorphismGroup, IrreducibleModules, Size, Centralizer, ConjugacyClasses, etc. Using pcgs-aware methods is often much faster.

rubrics_metrics.name: ClassesSolvableGroup
rubrics_metrics.description: Computes conjugacy classes and centralizers in solvable groups. The 'mode' parameter selects calculation type: 0 for conjugacy classes, 4 for conjugacy test for two elements provided in opt.candidates.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Returns in mode 0 a list of records with 'representative' and 'centralizer'; in mode 4 returns a conjugating element. Optional record 'opt' may contain: pcgs (must return an appropriate series of normal subgroups with elementary abelian factors; for rational classes must refine a central series), candidates (list of elements for which canonical representatives are computed or conjugacy test performed; returned records include operator such that candidate^operator = representative), and consider (a function consider(fhome, rep, cenp, K, L) called before lifting that can prune representatives — e.g., to compute only classes with small centralizers or restricted orders).

rubrics_metrics.name: CentralizerSizeLimitConsiderFunction
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns a consider-function suitable for use in ClassesSolvableGroup that restricts lifting to only those classes for which the size of the centralizer (in the factor) is at most a given size sz.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Useful to prune class-lifting when only small-centralizer classes are of interest; can improve performance.

rubrics_metrics.name: FamilyPcgs
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns for a pc group grp a 'natural' pcgs of some group G which contains grp and is maximal with this property. This is the family pcgs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: FamilyPcgs is the pcgs coming from a power-conjugate presentation; pcgs-operations are particularly efficient with respect to this pcgs.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsFamilyPcgs
rubrics_metrics.description: Specifies whether a pcgs is the FamilyPcgs of a pc group.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to detect if a pcgs is the canonical family pcgs; many low-level algorithms assume or benefit from family pcgs.

rubrics_metrics.name: InducedPcgsWrtFamilyPcgs
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns the pcgs induced with respect to a family pcgs (i.e., induced pcgs of subgroups with respect to family pcgs).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to obtain induced pcgs that are compatible with the family pcgs of a parent group.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsParentPcgsFamilyPcgs
rubrics_metrics.description: Property indicating that the parent pcgs is induced with respect to a family pcgs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Distinguishes between independent pc generating sequences a pc group may have; non-family pcgs operations may be less efficient. If family pcgs chosen for arithmetic is not important, changing to a 'nicer' pcgs (e.g., via IsomorphismSpecialPcGroup) can speed up calculations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Comparison of elements of pc groups (\= and \<)
rubrics_metrics.description: Elements of a pc group are represented as words in normal form wrt the family pcgs, so comparison reduces to comparison of exponent vectors with respect to the family pcgs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Word problem is efficiently solvable for pc groups due to normal-form exponent-vector representation; comparisons are straightforward.

rubrics_metrics.name: Arithmetic operations for elements of pc groups (\* and Inverse)
rubrics_metrics.description: Multiplication and inversion of elements in pc groups are performed using 'collection' to transform concatenated words into normal form; not just concatenation/reversion as in arbitrary fp groups.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Collection algorithm is necessary to keep words in normal form; examples show typical multiplication and inversion results.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsPcGroup
rubrics_metrics.description: Test whether a given group G is a pc group.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Useful to check whether group-specific pc-group methods can be applied; pc groups are implemented separately from fp groups in GAP.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsomorphismFpGroupByPcgs
rubrics_metrics.description: Computes the power-commutator (power-conjugate) presentation defined by a pcgs and returns an isomorphism to an fp group. The string argument can name the generators of the fp group.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Converts a pc group description into an fp-group presentation; will error if pc presentation is not confluent.

rubrics_metrics.name: PcGroupFpGroup
rubrics_metrics.description: Creates a pc group P from an fp group G whose presentation is polycyclic (confluent pc presentation required).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Constructs a pc group from a suitable finitely presented group; will error if presentation not confluent.

rubrics_metrics.name: SingleCollector / CombinatorialCollector
rubrics_metrics.description: Initializes a collector (data structure for collecting) with a free group fgrp and list of relative orders relorders. CombinatorialCollector is only for finite p-groups (all relorders equal to the same prime).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Collectors are used to build pc presentations by hand (SetConjugate/SetCommutator/SetPower) and then GroupByRws. Intended for experts; little argument checking.

rubrics_metrics.name: SetConjugate
rubrics_metrics.description: For a collector coll and indices i<j, sets the conjugate f_j^{ -1} f_i f_j (or the conjugate f_j f_i f_j^{-1} depending on underlying conventions) to equal w, where w is assumed canonical in generators fi+1..fn.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: No checking performed; used when assembling a power-conjugate presentation in a collector manually.

rubrics_metrics.name: SetCommutator
rubrics_metrics.description: For a collector coll and i<j, sets the commutator of f_j and f_i equal to w, assumed to be canonical in fi+1..fn.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: No checking performed; low-level collector operation.

rubrics_metrics.name: SetPower
rubrics_metrics.description: For a collector coll and index i, sets the power f_i^{r_i} equal to w, assumed canonical in fi+1..fn (r_i is the relative order).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: No checking performed; used to add power relations to the collector.

rubrics_metrics.name: GroupByRws / GroupByRwsNC
rubrics_metrics.description: Creates a group from a rewriting system (collector). GroupByRws checks whether rewriting system is confluent; GroupByRwsNC assumes confluence without checking.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use NC version when you know your presentation is confluent to skip expensive checks.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsConfluent (for pc groups)
rubrics_metrics.description: Checks whether the pc group G has been built from a collector with a confluent power-commutator presentation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Confluence is required for correct pc-group behavior in GAP; examples illustrate groups that are/are not confluent and effect on group properties.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsomorphismRefinedPcGroup
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns an isomorphism from G onto an isomorphic pc group whose family pcgs is a prime-order pcgs (refined).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Useful when algorithms require prime-order defining pcgs for efficiency or compatibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: RefinedPcGroup
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns the range (image) of the IsomorphismRefinedPcGroup value of G (i.e., the refined pc group).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use together with IsomorphismRefinedPcGroup to obtain a pc group with prime-order family pcgs.

rubrics_metrics.name: PcGroupWithPcgs
rubrics_metrics.description: Creates a new pc group G whose family pcgs is isomorphic to the (modulo) pcgs mpcgs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If a pcgs is given by a list of pc elements, PcgsByPcSequence can be used first; useful for converting induced/modulo-pcgs into an explicit pc group.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsomorphismPcGroup
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns an isomorphism from G onto an isomorphic pc group; the series chosen depends on the method.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: G must be a polycyclic group (any representation). Useful to convert general polycyclic groups (e.g., solvable permutation groups) into pc-group representation for pc-specific operations.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsomorphismSpecialPcGroup
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns an isomorphism from G onto an isomorphic pc group whose family pcgs is a special pcgs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Can improve runtime of calculations; applicable to polycyclic groups of any kind.

rubrics_metrics.name: GapInputPcGroup
rubrics_metrics.description: Generates GAP input code for grp with name 'string' suitable for saving and later reading to reconstruct the group (printing a pc group does not display its presentation).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use PrintTo file with GapInputPcGroup to save a pc group persistently; reading the file recreates a group with same small-group ID although object equality may differ.

rubrics_metrics.name: Operations for Pc Groups (general note)
rubrics_metrics.description: All operations described in Chapters 39 and 45 apply to a pc group; most methods for pc groups are methods for groups with pcgs. The only pc-group-special method called out is a special method to compute intersections of subgroups (because a pcgs of a parent group is needed).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: In practice, pc-group methods mirror polycyclic-group operations but can include pc-group-specific optimizations; where parent-pcgs are needed (intersection) pc-group representation guarantees availability.

rubrics_metrics.name: TwoCoboundaries
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns the group of 2-coboundaries of a pc group G by a G-module M. Generators of M must correspond to the Pcgs value of G. The group is given as a vector space over the field underlying M.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used in cohomology computations for extensions; M must be represented compatibly with pcgs (module matrices correspond to pcgs).

rubrics_metrics.name: TwoCocycles
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns the 2-cocycles of a pc group G by the G-module M as a list of vectors over the field underlying M; the additive group generated by these vectors is the group of 2-cocycles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Generators of M must correspond to the Pcgs of G; output is a vector-space description of cocycles.

rubrics_metrics.name: TwoCohomology
rubrics_metrics.description: Computes the second cohomology group for the special case of a pc group. Returns a record defining the second cohomology group as factor space of cocycles by coboundaries. G must be a pc group and generators of M must correspond to pcgs of G.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Result includes linear mapping and vector-space descriptions; essential for extension enumeration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Extensions
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns all extensions of G by the G-module M up to equivalence as pc groups.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Extensions returned are up to equivalence but not necessarily up to isomorphism; useful for enumerating possible extension classes represented as pc groups.

rubrics_metrics.name: Extension / ExtensionNC
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns the extension of G by the G-module M via the cocycle c as a pc group. The NC variant does not check the resulting group for consistency.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ExtensionNC is faster but unsafe if cocycle or data might be inconsistent; Extension checks consistency.

rubrics_metrics.name: SplitExtension
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns the split extension of G by the G-module M (two-argument version) or the 3-argument version described elsewhere.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Split extensions do not require M to be elementary abelian for this construction; see other functions for split-extension variants.

rubrics_metrics.name: ModuleOfExtension
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns the module (normal subgroup) of an extension E of G by M corresponding to M.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Useful to inspect the normal subgroup in the extension that realizes the module M.

rubrics_metrics.name: CompatiblePairs
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns the group of compatible pairs of the group G with the G-module M as a subgroup of Aut(G) × Aut(M). Optional first argument A can be a subgroup of Aut(G) to avoid computing the full automorphism group; optional D restricts computation to pairs in D.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Compatible-pairs act on second cohomology; orbits under this action correspond to isomorphism classes of extensions modulo the action. Use optional arguments to limit automorphism computations and speed up calculations.

rubrics_metrics.name: ExtensionRepresentatives
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns all extensions of G by the G-module M up to equivalence under action of a given group P (P must be provided).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to compute extension representatives modulo the action of a subgroup of compatible pairs or automorphisms; continues the extension/enumeration workflow.
